// A complete morphological operation: what to do, with which element shape,
// how large, and how many times.
type MorphologyParameters
    implements IValue
{
    Operation: MorphologyOperation;
    Element: StructuringElement;
    Radius: Integer;
    Iterations: Integer;
}

// A thresholding operation for reducing an image to two (or clamped) levels.
// The fixed-level kinds carry their normalized cutoff; Otsu computes its own
// global level; the adaptive kinds carry the local window size and an offset
// that biases the computed local level.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thresholding_(image_processing))
type Threshold
    = Binary(Level: Proportion)
    | BinaryInverted(Level: Proportion)
    | Truncate(Level: Proportion)
    | ToZero(Level: Proportion)
    | Otsu
    | AdaptiveMean(BlockSize: Integer, Offset: Number)
    | AdaptiveGaussian(BlockSize: Integer, Offset: Number);

//==
// # IImage processing - resampling, quantization, and lens effects
//
// Operations that change an image's sampling grid, its color precision, or its
// apparent optics: reconstruction filters and resize settings, lossless
// reorientation, dithering and color quantization, denoising, vignetting, and
// chromatic aberration. These are parameter records - pure data consumed by
// processing functions in a later pass. Distances and radii are in pixels
// unless noted.

//==
// ## Resampling, quantization, and lens effects

// A reconstruction filter used when resampling an image.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Image_scaling)
type ResampleFilter
    = Nearest | Bilinear | Bicubic | Lanczos2 | Lanczos3 | Mitchell | CatmullRom | Box;

// Resize settings. When PreserveAspect is true the image is fit within
// TargetSize keeping its aspect ratio; otherwise it stretches to fill.
type ResizeParameters
    implements IValue
{
    TargetSize: IntegerSize2D;
    Filter: ResampleFilter;
    PreserveAspect: Boolean;
}

// A lossless pixel reorientation (the eight EXIF orientations).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Exif)
type ImageOrientation
    = Identity
    | FlipHorizontal
    | Rotate180
    | FlipVertical
    | Transpose
    | Rotate90
    | Transverse
    | Rotate270;

// An error-diffusion or ordered-dithering pattern used when reducing color
// depth. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dither)
type Dither
    = None | Bayer2 | Bayer4 | Bayer8 | FloydSteinberg | Atkinson | BlueNoise | WhiteNoise;

// Color-quantization settings: reduce an image to at most ColorCount palette
// entries, hiding banding with the chosen dither.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Color_quantization)
type QuantizeParameters
    implements IValue
{
    ColorCount: Integer;
    Dither: Dither;
}

// Edge-preserving denoise settings: Strength sets how aggressively noise is
// removed within Radius, while PreserveDetail protects fine structure.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Noise_reduction)
type DenoiseParameters
    implements IValue
{
    Strength: Proportion;
    Radius: Integer;
    PreserveDetail: Proportion;
}

// A vignette: darkening toward the frame edges. Radius is where falloff
// begins (0 center, 1 corners); Softness widens the transition; Center is in
// normalized UV coordinates. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vignetting)
type VignetteParameters
    implements IValue
{
    Strength: Proportion;
    Radius: Proportion;
    Softness: Proportion;
    Center: UvCoordinate;
}

// Chromatic aberration: radial separation of the color channels away from
// Center (normalized UV), Strength in pixels at the frame corner.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chromatic_aberration)
type ChromaticAberrationParameters
    implements IValue
{
    Strength: Number;
    Center: UvCoordinate;
}
